content.text: afterward shall they come out with great substance, Gen. 15:14. God is come to prove you, Ex. 20:20. Moses, Come up unto the Lord, Ex. 24:1. said David … Thou comest to me with a sword, 1 Sam. 17:45. all things come of thee, 1 Chr. 29:14. Lo, I come, Ps. 40:7 (Heb. 10:7). unto thee shall all flesh come, Ps. 65:2. Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord, Ps. 118:26 (Matt. 21:9; 23:39; Mark 11:9; Luke 13:35; 19:38; John 12:13). your God will come with vengeance, Isa. 35:4. Incline your ear, and come unto me, Isa. 55:3. the Gentiles shall come to thy light, Isa. 60:3. until he come whose right it is, Ezek. 21:27. Lord cometh forth out of his place, Micah 1:3. thy King cometh, Zech. 9:9 (Matt. 21:5; John 12:15). Lord … shall suddenly come to his temple, Mal. 3:1 (3 Ne. 24:1; D&C 36:8; 133:2).

Thy kingdom come, Matt. 6:10 (Luke 11:2). Art thou he that should come, Matt. 11:3 (Luke 7:19). Come unto me, all ye that labour, Matt. 11:28. If any man will come after me, Matt. 16:24 (Mark 8:34; Luke 9:23). Suffer little children … to come unto me, Matt. 19:14 (Mark 10:14; Luke 18:16). Son of man came not to be ministered unto, Matt. 20:28 (Mark 10:45). many shall come in my name, Matt. 24:5 (Mark 13:6; Luke 21:8). they shall see the Son of man coming, Matt. 24:30 (Mark 13:26; Luke 21:27; JS—M 1:36). in such an hour … the Son of man cometh, Matt. 24:44 (Luke 12:40). Son of man … coming in the clouds of heaven, Matt. 26:64 (Dan. 7:13; Mark 14:62; D&C 76:63). Jesus said … Come ye after me, Mark 1:17. Hold thy peace, and come out of him, Mark 1:25 (Luke 4:35). when he came to himself, Luke 15:17. kingdom of God cometh not with observation, Luke 17:20. when the Son of man cometh, shall he find faith, Luke 18:8. He came unto his own, John 1:11. saith unto them, Come and see, John 1:39. he that came down from heaven, John 3:13. ye will not come to me, that ye might have life, John 5:40. I am come in my Father’s name, John 5:43. he that cometh to me shall never hunger, John 6:35. All that the Father giveth me shall come to me, John 6:37. I came down from heaven, John 6:38. No man can come to me, except the Father … draw him, John 6:44. I am not come of myself, John 7:28 (8:42). thither ye cannot come, John 7:34 (7:36; 8:21–22; 13:33). I proceeded forth and came from God, John 8:42 (16:28). I am come that they might have life, John 10:10. Lazarus, come forth, John 11:43. for this cause came I unto this hour, John 12:27. that he was come from God, John 13:3. I will come again, and receive you unto myself, John 14:3. no man cometh unto the Father, but by me, John 14:6. not leave you comfortless: I will come to you, John 14:18. I came out from thee, John 17:8. If I will that he tarry till I come, John 21:22. same Jesus … shall so come in like manner, Acts 1:11. Come over into Macedonia, Acts 16:9. desire these many years to come unto you, Rom. 15:23. ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come, 1 Cor. 11:26. come out from among them, 2 Cor. 6:17. Till we all come in the unity of the faith, Eph. 4:13. gospel came not unto you in word only, 1 Thes. 1:5. Jesus came into the world to save sinners, 1 Tim. 1:15. save them to the uttermost that come unto God, Heb. 7:25. he that cometh to God must believe that he is, Heb. 11:6. he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ, 1 Jn. 5:6. Lord cometh with ten thousands of his saints, Jude 1:14. cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, Rev. 1:7. or else I will come unto thee quickly, Rev. 2:5. I come quickly, Rev. 3:11 (22:7; D&C 33:18; 35:27; 41:4; 54:10). I will come in to him, and will sup with him, Rev. 3:20. Come out of her, my people, Rev. 18:4. the Spirit and the bride say, Come, Rev. 22:17.

he cometh, according to the words, 1 Ne. 19:8. Christ … should come among the Jews, 2 Ne. 10:3. inviteth them all to come unto him, 2 Ne. 26:33. will repent and come unto me, 2 Ne. 28:32. God himself shall come down, Mosiah 15:1. we must come forth and stand before him, Alma 12:15. five years … then cometh the Son, Hel. 14:2. on the morrow come I into the world, 3 Ne. 1:13. come unto me and be ye saved, 3 Ne. 12:20. prepare the way whereby they may come unto me, 3 Ne. 21:27. come unto Christ, Moro. 10:32.

cometh unto me, the same is my church, D&C 10:67. that all men might repent and come unto him, D&C 18:11. I came by the will of the Father, D&C 19:24. dead awake … and they shall come forth, D&C 29:26. time … surely shall come, D&C 39:21. in mine own due time will I come, D&C 43:29. great day of the Lord to come, D&C 45:39. even so shall ye come unto me, D&C 45:46. Son of Man cometh not in the form of a woman, D&C 49:22. I am Jesus Christ, who cometh quickly, D&C 51:20. will come down in heaven from the presence of my Father, D&C 63:34. righteous cometh down from above, D&C 67:9 (133:46). he came into the world, even Jesus, to be crucified, D&C 76:41.
